definitions.healthy: paired healthy injection from the same selected source
definitions.fault_backend_mean: mean of ten backend seeds per state; EIR L2 rows then average five SA state means
definitions.state_backend_min_max: range across SA state means, separate from backend_sample_min/max
definitions.EIR_representative: median backend mean among the five stopped-tier states, tie smallest SA seed; used only by joint simulation
definitions.fault_layer: sum of per-operator state means; prefill 2LN+8MHA+proj+FFN, decode LN+8MHA+proj+FFN
definitions.FULL: A3h PF4 only, best backend mean of fourteen 1000-step candidates
definitions.decision_timing: saved parallel-run elapsed measurements; serial paper timing remains stage J
definitions.early_stop_timing: R0/L1 t_decision follows the original EIR sum of t_R0 and applicable t_L1; final state evaluation and ten-seed backend time are listed separately
definitions.KV_overlap: intersection of the KV bounding interval and actual D first-start/end interval; not a per-link waiting trace
definitions.unhidden_components: original backend triple; not DDR/NoC/D2D queue attribution
